image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a small mustelid (likely a stoat or weasel) resting on light-colored sand. The animal has a slender, elongated body with brown fur on its back and white/cream fur on its underside. Its head is triangular with a pointed snout, dark eyes, and short rounded ears. The legs are short and partially tucked or obscured by the body angle. The tail is visible at the rear, appearing relatively short.
